raccoon_bachelor.label: 🦝 Bachelor raccoon — quick dinner
raccoon_bachelor.blurb: Bins on the curb the night before garbage day, plus restaurant dumpsters. Eat and leave.

raccoon_family.label: 🦝🦝🦝 Raccoon family — settle down
raccoon_family.blurb: Dependable weekly supply (garbage AND recycling nights), quiet streets, big trees to den in, low roadkill risk.

raccoon_date_night.label: 🦝💘 Raccoon looking for a mate
raccoon_date_night.blurb: Go where the other raccoons are: highest trash density, late, near the bars. Bring a snack.

raccoon_buffet.label: 🦝🛋️ Heavy-trash buffet
raccoon_buffet.blurb: Monthly heavy-trash service: couches, fridges, mystery bags. Yard waste night as a chaser.

human_resident_11pm.label: 🚗 Resident, home at 11 PM
human_resident_11pm.blurb: Residential frontage with room, quiet street, away from commercial spillover, late evening.

human_delivery_driver.label: 📦 Delivery driver, needs a curb
human_delivery_driver.blurb: Commercial frontage, capacity, no bus stop in the way, off-peak hours.

human_311_hotspot.label: 🏛️ City ops — where do complaints stack?
human_311_hotspot.blurb: Parking complaints + missed collections + illegal dumping on the same face. One crew, one trip.

food_truck_friday.label: 🌮 Food truck, Friday night
food_truck_friday.blurb: Commercial frontage, room to park a truck, foot traffic implied by bars, not a bus stop, not a bike lane.

homebuyer_quiet_dry.label: 🏠 Homebuyer: quiet and dry
homebuyer_quiet_dry.blurb: Residential street, low traffic, out of the floodplain, parks and trees nearby, not a nightlife spillover block.

reasons.flood: FEMA AE zone is a hard no

city_ops_one_truck.label: 🚛 City ops: one truck, most fixes
city_ops_one_truck.blurb: Stack missed pickups, dumping, dead-animal calls and streetlight outages on the same block; send one crew.
